_help: Edit values here; nothing is typed into the page itself. An empty value shows as "Coming soon". Never fill a slot with a guess. Entries can be added, removed or reordered freely. Callouts point at a spot on the pod: "anchor" must be one of sensor, clip, pod_top, pod_rear, pod_front (from data/anchors.json). A callout with a "detail" sentence can be opened (hover, click or keyboard) once all callouts are showing; leave it empty for none.

callouts.heading: Blink sensor
callouts.detail: A tiny infrared sensor at the end of a short arm, near the lens, follows how often and how fully you blink. It cannot take pictures.

callouts.heading: Clip
callouts.detail: The pod is designed to clip onto one temple of the glasses you already own, so there is no new frame and no new prescription.
